metadata.method_name: FRLP output-space share test (substitute vs ladder)
metadata.description: Forced-ratio latent probabilities (mixture-proposal importance sampling over forced programs, yield-corrected) scored by teacher forcing on Qwen3-8B; single-ban gain profiles decomposed into a generic ladder share (external profile from nonce bans, matched-norm random prompt-band edits and a novelty instruction) and an X-specific residual, with an aim test against the prime-and-veto and free-form association profiles.

association.rule: first catalogue name matched by the lexicon that is not X; A_X(j) = (count_j + 1) / (20 + |S_X|)

override.decision: proceed with the cached-prefix path in fp32-activation/TF32 precision for EVERY condition
override.reason: (i) per-program 0.074 <= 0.25 passes; (i) contrast 0.119 misses 0.10 narrowly; (ii) within-path B=1 vs B=8 0.045 passes. The residual cached-vs-full gap is TF32 rounding between the masked (cached) and unmasked (full) attention kernels, not a cache bug: with bf16 activations the same checks gave 2.13/3.17/2.69 nats, and with fp32 logits but bf16 activations 1.62/1.78/1.38 (logs/scorer_validation_*_FAILED.json). Production never mixes paths.

openrouter_cost.note: judge calls (openai/gpt-4.1-mini) for runtime/AST disagreements only; cap USD 0.5

deviations: Yield correction: L = log y_j + logmeanexp(lw) is primary for the gate and implied distributions; the literal formula L_raw is reported beside it (gains/C1 unaffected).
Neutral-twin filler ' .'; 0 alignment failures over 190 pairs.

Noun ranking: all 718 noun-bank candidates are single-token, so the rank reduces to SUBTLEX frequency; a minimal neutrality screen removed one vulgar word and path/data-structure words (prompts_v2.json rules.noun_exclusions).
vLLM ran with enforce_eager=True (no C compiler in the container), max_num_seqs=48 (plan: 8) for throughput on the L4; per-request seeds make the sampled distribution independent of batching.

Scorer precision: bf16 activations failed validation (cached vs full up to 2.1 nats per program; B=1 vs B=8 contrast 2.7 nats). Production scoring keeps bf16 weights but runs fp32 activations with TF32 matmuls and an fp32 lm_head/log-softmax: per-program cached-vs-full 0.074 (passes 0.25), contrast 0.119 (misses 0.10 narrowly), B=1 vs B=8 0.045 (passes). One path is used for every condition.
Cut rule fired: measured 1046 tok/s (TF32) projected Q1-Q6 at M=30 to 242 min > 150 -> M=20 programs per algorithm (halves of 10) and the gate on 3 paraphrases.
pipeline.py (exp1 stage code) was copied in addition to the plan's list because its label_rows/evaluate_unique implement the canonical labeller orchestration; its evaluation cache points into data/.
Gate events: the realised mode / clear-mode test is computed over the allowed labels (banned labels excluded under a ban).
Variant (ii) uses ||h|| of the layer-18 OUTPUT at each edited position; its program-position edit is applied at every teacher-forced input position.

Free-form answers: {'t1': 0.06666666666666667, 't2': 0.47} truncated at the frozen 32 tokens; labelled 'other' shares {'t1': 0.0, 't2': 0.28} (association profiles are therefore weak; secondary aim only).

protocol.tokenisation: prompt (chat string) and response tokenised separately, add_special_tokens=False, concatenated
protocol.precision: bf16 weights; fp32 activations; TF32 matmuls; fp32 lm_head + log-softmax
protocol.ess_flag: cells with ESS < 5 are flagged; ESS-weighted variant down-weights them by ESS/5
